create_feedforward_controller: create a FeedForward RNN core controller with a specified hidden size and activation function
build_deep_core: build a deep control module with multiple stacked RNN layers and optional skip connections
get_controller_ctor: get the constructor for an RNN controller by name such as LSTM or GRU
test_feedforward_call: test the FeedForward controller __call__ method with input tensors and previous state
review_deep_core: review the deep_core function that constructs stacked RNN controllers with configurable layers
